title: Benchmarks
text: Values drawn 0 10 million minus one. bit vector needs whole universe front; stores value v position v + 1. Three kinds set show representation strong: dense: half universe, chosen random; sparse: one value thousand, chosen random; runs: twenty long stretches consecutive values.
code: set.seed(2026) universe <- 1e7 sets <- list(   dense = sort(sample(universe, universe / 2) - 1L),   sparse = sort(sample(universe, universe / 1000) - 1L),   runs = sort(unique(unlist(lapply(     seq(0, universe - 400000, length.out = 20),     function(start) as.integer(start) + 0:199999   )))) ) lengths(sets) #>   dense  sparse    runs  #> 5000000   10000 4000000  as_bit <- function(v) {   b <- bit(universe)   b[v + 1L] <- TRUE   b }

title: zuroar 0.1.0
text: New package: compressed sets unsigned integers built bundled copy CRoaring 5.4.0. First release. zuroar_info() reports bundled CRoaring version, SIMD paths compiled , instruction sets processor offers. roar() roar_range() build 32-bit bitmap; roar_add() roar_remove() return changed copy, sharing unchanged containers; roar_contains() tests membership. bitmap ALTREP double vector reads values compressed form demand never expands behind back: survives saveRDS(), serialize() trip mirai parallel worker, can data-frame column, answers length(), x[[k]], x[] (bitmap), head(), tail(), %%, match(), sum(), min(), max(), range(), .integer(), .double(), format(), print(), lapply(). operation need values plain vector, x[1] <- 5 identical(x, y), error; compare sets ==. Errors inherit zuroar_error, zuroar_error_value, zuroar_error_index, zuroar_error_unsupported, zuroar_error_format zuroar_error_memory specific cases. Set algebra: |, &, roar_xor(), roar_andnot(), roar_union(), roar_intersect() c() build bitmaps; ==, !=, <=, <, >= > compare sets; roar_cardinality(), roar_jaccard(), roar_intersects() roar_disjoint() answer without building one. roar_flip() flips range. x + k, x - k roar_shift() shift every value; leaving domain error unless roar_shift(drop = TRUE). Ordered queries: roar_rank(), roar_select() (1), roar_next(), roar_prev(), roar_count() roar_contains_range(), inclusive ranges; roar_values() extracts bounded number values. roar_add() roar_remove() take range. sort() unique() return bitmap; [<-, [[<-, rev() sort(decreasing = TRUE) errors. roar_optimize(), roar_stats() roar_size() show tune bitmap stored. roar_serialize() roar_unserialize() write read portable Roaring format shared Java, Go, Rust Python. Reading treats bytes untrusted: bounded, validated, zuroar_error_format anything corrupt, including corrupt .rds file. roar_serial_config() configures mirai daemons 64-bit class come; 32-bit bitmaps need configuration. roar64() roar64_range() build zuroar64, bitmap values 2^64 - 1 crosses R decimal text doubles 2^53. 32-bit API; roar64_length() gives exact size roar64_unserialize() reads portable bytes. Every change zuroar64 copies , since CRoaring’s 64-bit bitmaps copy--write. README, Get started article benchmarks article measures time memory base R bit package.
